title: Vacas en central park
alt: A giant skeleton cow stands among Manhattan skyscrapers at dusk above Central Park's green hills and pond, while two small skeletons sit by the water at the lower right.

title: Can’t Waste No Time, She Might Leave Soon
alt: A long-haired woman sits cross-legged by a lake and mountains, embraced from behind by a skeleton.

title: La Patrona de Brooklyn
alt: A blond-haired woman with gold jewelry sits wrapped in a checkered shawl in a bar draped with a Puerto Rican flag, with green figures behind her.

title: Dragonrider
alt: A skeleton in a dark jacket does a handstand beside a large horned skeleton beast, against a red panel marked 424, blue walls and an orange floor.

title: la perdición
alt: A crowd of skeletons gathers on an orange and red floor beneath a swirling turquoise sky, with a skeleton inside a glowing yellow sun, winged skeletons flying, and stacked skulls on both sides.

title: next week is the fries
alt: A figure in a red hood, grey bomber jacket, patterned jeans and black boots walks across a bright green tiled floor past a red table stacked with burger boxes, under a cloudy turquoise sky and a rope-netted dome.

title: Las Verandas de Brooklyn
alt: A skeleton lies on a white-sheeted bed in a dark room. Light from an open shuttered window falls across the floor, and sunflowers wind along the skeleton.

title: Atardecer con una Diosa
alt: A giant green eye hangs over a sparkling sea. A blue bull-headed figure in a robe sits at a red-and-white checkered picnic with bones.

title: Ballet en el Amazonas
alt: A troupe of skeletons in dark red tutus and red ballet shoes dance on a black-and-white checkered floor framed by sunflowers and vines.

title: Anti-Auto Retrato en Cartagena
alt: A large green skull and skeleton in front of colonial yellow and orange buildings and a clock tower, with small skeletons at tables.

title: La Madona del’ Carmen
alt: A haloed woman in a blue cloak holds a small yellow skeleton child. A church clock tower rises behind them against a blue sky.

title: Nuestra Historia
alt: Two olive-green skulls face each other under a night sky of planets and eyes, above a green field and a ribcage.

title: El Alakran y las Flores
alt: A skeleton goalkeeper dives to stop a flaming soccer ball inside a goal, with a stadium crowd made of flowers behind.

title: La Reina de Williasmburg
alt: A woman with curly blond hair and bright rings wears a Puerto Rican flag cape in front of a stylized city skyline and bridge.

title: El Hermano de la Monalisa
alt: A man in colorful sunglasses and a skeletal jaw wears a checkered monogram shirt and a chain, posed like the Mona Lisa before a landscape.

title: pensando en la penumbra
alt: Two black skeletons sit with their backs to us in front of two tall barred windows, looking out at a blue sky fading to an orange sunset, with white light streaks across a dark grey wall.

title: Data
alt: A skull with a pink bob haircut and wide staring eyes, wired up with bundles of colorful cables that arc across a dark grey and blue background.

title: LUX
alt: A skeleton wrapped in a white hood, its head tilted and arms crossed over its ribs, glows against a deep turquoise and blue spray-painted background with paint drips.

title: Skedgar
alt: A cartoon squid character with a mop of black hair and red-rimmed eyes, drawn in a spray-painted turquoise scene with rippled vertical lines, white squiggles, a small skeleton, a QR code and the words Squedgar Calamardo and Trippypug.

title: T(hee-hee)hriller
alt: A troupe of dancing skeletons in a synchronized zombie-dance pose, the lead in a red jacket, against a glowing blue and white cloudy sky and a dark stage floor with long shadows.

title: Los 3
alt: Three skeletons with red muscle-colored limbs tumble together in a spider web, one upside down, above a blue and white checkered floor with two blue orbs and a pug-faced drum, under a purple sky with a pale moon.

title: lucho y brazil
alt: Skeleton soccer players on a green field with white boundary lines, one diving in the air toward a flaming soccer ball, while others run and a skull peeks up at the bottom.

title: Love club
alt: A winged skeleton horse flies above a red and white striped wall, with green vines hanging from a yellow band, a grinning mouth with watching eyes in the middle, and a field of pink and yellow flowers below.

title: chromacopia
alt: A thickly painted black, white and pale yellow portrait of a figure with two round hair buns, a pale halo behind the head, and a skeletal hand raised at the left.

title: Omerta
alt: Two skeletons in 1940s-style gangster clothes, one in a white fedora, tan overcoat and red tie, the other in sunglasses and a red fur-trimmed coat, stand on a Brooklyn street in front of a red brick building under a stormy grey sky.

title: Marrrrcria
alt: A small curled-up skeleton with dark curly hair rests its chin on its hand, floating in the middle of a large pale blue and white brushed background.
